text:
Noah: opened PR #973 - small docs fix + JS SDK example tweaks. Vercel preview shows broken anchor links and one image 404. link: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/deployments/3001
Rina: can you add the preview link in the PR description? easier to click from GH checks
Noah: done. PR description now includes local reproduction steps and the Vercel link. I used /static/img/overview.png in the markdown and Vercel rewrote it to /img which broke it
ci-bot: Deployment 3001 finished: succeeded with warnings. Warning: rewrite rules applied for /static/ assets. Runner image: redwood/doc-preview:20260410
Theo: looks like our static folder mapping changed in the theme upgrade. Quick fix: move image reference to img/overview.png and update links. Also add explicit anchor ids for headings that jump
Rina: pushed a tiny commit fixing image path and added heading ids. Also added a one-line note in the JS snippet: // set REDWOOD_API_URL when testing against Dedicated
Noah: re-running preview now
ci-bot: Rebuild 3002 triggered by Rina. Deployment 3002 succeeded. Preview: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/deployments/3002 
Theo: preview looks good. Who's comfortable approving? I can do a quick technical pass
Rina: I'll confirm wording and merge during the end-of-day merge slot (17:30 PT) if no objections
Noah: thanks. I filed issue #329 to add a docs CI check that scans for absolute/static asset paths before previews run
Theo: +1 to the CI check. Saves a lot of back-and-forth for small path changes
Rina: approving now :white_check_mark:
Theo: approved and will merge at 17:30 PT.
